prose: Basis: a thin cache containing only the artist's own post. IAMDDB publicly called out Israel for a propaganda video featuring an AI-generated version of her, made without her consent - 'why did you steal my identity for something I 100% did not consent to?' Her post drew roughly a million views within hours.
The underlying video appears to have been removed or made unavailable.
highlights: Israeli propaganda video used an AI-generated IAMDDB without consent
The artist denounced it publicly; ~1M views in hours
The referenced post/video is no longer available
Basis: only the artist's post retrievable
